children: Kingfisher's Screwfix business continues to be a major driver of the company's outperformance, analysts at Berenberg say in a note. The brand's strong volume growth boosted like-for-like-sales in the first half, the analysts write. Beyond this, Screwfix's strong trade sales can be attributed to its rewards program, which continues to resonate well and drive loyalty, the analysts say. (aimee.look@wsj.com)
